author: bd-spin/bd-spin-20260511T043600Z-4169702
text:
Closed by commit 0fdcd02. Mirror of JMAP-hwdv.1 canonical pattern.

Acceptance criteria status:
- cargo test -p jmap-sharing-server --features memory: pass (25 tests, 1 doctest passed, 1 ignored)
- cargo test -p jmap-sharing-server (via self-dev-dep): pass (same 25 tests)
- cargo check -p jmap-sharing-server --no-default-features: pass (memory NOT in default)
- cargo clippy -p jmap-sharing-server --features memory --tests -- -D warnings: pass
- RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-sharing-server --features memory --no-deps: pass
- tests/common/mod.rs ≤ 200 LoC of helpers: 15 LoC (well under target — sharing-server had no FaultyBackend equivalent so the shim is genuinely tiny)
- Naming exactly matches canonical (.1): module name `memory`, types `MemoryBackend`/`MemoryError`, feature `memory`, dev-dep self-feature pattern
- workspace pre-commit gate (cargo fmt + cargo clippy --workspace + cargo test --workspace): pass (1,471 tests, 0 fail)

Notable deltas from canonical .1 (all justified by sharing-server having a simpler MemoryBackend than mail-server):
- No optional deps added — sharing-server's MemoryBackend uses only types already in [dependencies] (no jmap-mime, no uuid, no mime-tree).
- No MdnBackend/SieveBackend gated impls — sharing-server has no analogous extensions.
- No seed module — sharing-server's MemoryBackend has no canonical seed data.
- Resulting tests/common/mod.rs shim is 15 LoC (vs mail-server's 325 LoC, which retained FaultyBackend + oracle blob constants).

Workspace test count delta: 1474 → 1471 (-3). The drop is benign: the single test inside the moved `mod tests { }` block previously ran 4× (once per integration binary that included `mod common;`), now runs once as a lib test. Same test, same assertions, fewer redundant invocations.

Side effect: tests/memory_backend.rs is now a 3-line stub running zero tests. Cleanup tracked in JMAP-hwdv.8 (P4).
